                                 TUESDAY, JULY 11, 2023

                                                    

     Printed daily by the State of Iowa during the sessions of the General Assembly. An
 official corrected copy is available for reference in the Secretary of the Senate’s Office.
 (The official bound copy will be available after a reasonable time upon adjournment.)

1096                    JOURNAL OF THE SENATE                               1st Day

             JOURNAL OF THE SENATE

                         FIRST CALENDAR DAY
                          FIRST SESSION DAY
                        EXTRAORDINARY SESSION

                              Senate Chamber
                  Des Moines, Iowa, Tuesday, July 11, 2023

  Pursuant to the proclamation of the Governor, the Honorable Kim
Reynolds, convening the Ninetieth General Assembly in Extraordinary
Session, the Senate was called to order at 8:34 a.m. by the Honorable
Amy Sinclair, President of the Senate.

[...]

                             FINAL ADJOURNMENT

  By virtue of House Concurrent Resolution 11, duly adopted,
President Sinclair declared the 2023 Extraordinary Session of the
Ninetieth General Assembly adjourned sine die.
